paragraphs: Friend, here's what I think this whole passage is about. God wants to be KNOWN. The LORD says, "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge" (Hosea 4:6). Nobody was missing a fact or two. They had "rejected knowledge" and "forgotten the law of your God" (Hosea 4:6), and everything else in the chapter grows out of that.

Look at what they chased in place of Him. They went to wooden idols for answers, and the LORD says wine and new wine "take away understanding" (Hosea 4:11-12). They ate but were not satisfied (Hosea 4:10). Friend, anything we run to instead of God leaves us hungry, and I know that feeling, because I tried to fill my days with dust for a LONG time.

So here's why it matters to you, baker. The chapter opens with a call: "Hear the word of the LORD" (Hosea 4:1). But hearing is only the start, friend, because the LORD named what was missing: "no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land" (Hosea 4:1). So let His Word shape how you live and love, because knowing Him is the best thing that ever came out of my oven.
